_README: Yad2 uses INTERNAL NUMERIC CODES for property types in its JSON feed.
These values MUST be confirmed against the live site (see README, section 'Resolving Yad2 IDs').
They are placed here as DATA so they can be corrected without touching code.
How to verify: open a Yad2 rental search in a browser, tick a single property
type in the filter, and read the 'property' query param value off the network tab.
The codes below reflect commonly-observed Yad2 values but are NOT guaranteed current.
